entities.name: Connectivity type
entities.description: Information element that indicates the type of connectivity for a PDN connection, specifically whether it is a LIPA PDN connection.

entities.name: Network configured to indicate LIPA PDN connection
entities.description: Condition where the network is configured to indicate when a PDN connection is a LIPA PDN connection.

entities.name: PDN connection is LIPA
entities.description: Condition where the present PDN connection is a LIPA PDN connection.

entities.name: Network includes Connectivity type IE
entities.description: Behavior where the network includes the Connectivity type IE in the message.

relations.description: The network behavior of including the Connectivity type IE establishes the presence of this IE in the message.
The inclusion of the Connectivity type IE is guarded by the condition that the network is configured to indicate LIPA PDN connections.
The inclusion of the Connectivity type IE is guarded by the condition that the present PDN connection is a LIPA PDN connection.
